blocks.text: Research inquiries banane ka matlab woh sawal banana hai jo tehqeeq ki rehnumai karein aur use us par markooz rakhein jo aap seekhna chahte hain. Soch samajh kar bana sawal kamyab project ka pehla qadam hai aur poori tehqeeq ka rukh tay karta hai (Did You Know).

Kitab kehti hai ke research sawalon ki mukhtalif qismein hain magar unhein bayan nahi karti; yeh aam ilm hai. Exploratory sawal kam samjhe gaye mauzoo ko khangal kar maloom karta hai ke kya ho raha hai (Class XI ke students ki parhai ki aadatein kya hain?). Explanatory sawal poochta hai ke kuch kyun ya kaise hota hai, wajoohat dhoondta hai (zyada sone wale students ke marks behtar kyun hain?). Hypothesis sawal par mabni qabil-e-aazmaish andaza hai (kam az kam aath ghante sone wale kam sone walon se zyada score karte hain); yeh batata hai ke kaunsa data jama karna hai aur saboot se sahih ya ghalat saabit ho sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Research sawal banate waqt khaas kyun hon (MCQ 4)? Exploratory aur explanatory sawalon mein farq (short question 3). Hypothesis kyun ahem hai (short question 4)?
blocks.explanation: (b) wazeh tay karna ke kya jaanna hai aur mubham sawalon se bachna. Exploratory sawal naye ya ghair wazeh mauzoo ko bayan karne ke liye khangalte hain; explanatory sawal kisi cheez ki wajoohat dhoondte hain. Hypothesis sawal ko qabil-e-aazmaish andaze mein badalta, jama karne wale data ko markooz karta aur nataij parakhne ka wazeh tareeqa deta hai.

blocks.prompt: Wazeh, markooz research sawal banane ka tareeqa achhi aur kharab misalon ke saath samjhaiye (long question 3). Class activity: kisi dilchasp mauzoo par sawal aur hypothesis likhein.
blocks.explanation: Wasee mauzoo se shuru kar ke ek pehlu tak mehdood karein, batayein kis ya kya ka mutala hai, variables aur mahol kya hain, aur yaqeeni banayein ke dastiyab data se jawab mil sakta hai. Kharab: 'Kya social media bura hai?' (mubham aur bohat wasee). Achha: 'Kya rozana do ghante se zyada social media hamare college ke Class XI students ka haftawar parhai ka waqt kam karta hai?' Mutabiq hypothesis: 'Rozana do ghante se zyada social media istemal karne wale students hafte mein kam ghante parhte hain.' Misalein aam ilm hain.

items: Achhe research sawal wazeh aur khaas; hypothesis qabil-e-aazmaish andaza; exploratory bayan, explanatory wajah.
